anchor.semantic_hook: Political leverage is made literal by feeding the contested resource into a pressure lever that physically presses down on a negotiation table.
anchor.setting: A government negotiation chamber contains a broad table, a delivery bay, a control plinth, and closed storage cabinets. A colossal steel pressure lever descends from the ceiling and crushes one end of the table deep into the floor, while its socket holds a removable object tray. Tall windows overlook a loading yard, and broad open floor surrounds the table.
anchor.absurd_element: a colossal pressure lever crushing the negotiation table into the floor

inserts.action: stands firmly at the control plinth, grips the pressure lever beside a shut gas valve, and watches the stranded fuel canisters with a calculating expression

variations.scene_adjust: add frost on the windows, a snow-covered delivery bay, insulated gas pipes, and several stranded fuel canisters

anchor.semantic_hook: The literal sequence after-as-before becomes a village square whose section after an arch remains physically identical to the section before it.

The road from the after half curves vertically into the sky and reconnects to the before half overhead, locking the square into an impossible loop. A bare market table and six open stalls stand around the square.
